instruction: Leslie has asked for my movie recommendations via phone text message. Reply to them with a list of comma-separated movie titles from my Simple Note account as per their request.
notes: Two-app information-flow task. supervisor.show_profile supplies the login usernames (phone number for phone, email for simple_note); show_account_passwords supplies passwords. phone.search_contacts (query "Leslie") discovers Leslie's phone number; phone.search_text_messages filtered by that number finds her request text, from which the director name is parsed (known-director). simple_note.search_notes finds the movie-recommendations note id and show_note reads its content; the reply message object's content is the comma-separated titles of that note filtered by the requested director, modeled by the static (reply-content msg director note) fact so send_text_message requires both known-director and note-read. The goal is that exactly one text (the filtered title list) is sent to Leslie; no answer is passed to complete_task. The optional dont_reorder_pinned flag used by the reference search_notes call is not modeled as it does not affect the plan structure.

plan: (phone-search-text-messages phone-token query-recommendation-suggestion-movie leslie-phone-number leslie-request-message leslie requested-director)
(phone-send-text-message leslie-phone-number reply-movie-titles phone-token leslie requested-director note-movie-recommendations)
